text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Former president Kamuzu Banda on Monday welcomed his Malawi Congress Party (MCP)'s boycott of Parliament saying it was good for purposes of strengthening the opposition.
- Three former members of the disbanded para-military Malawi Young Pioneers charged with murdering two soldiers were on Monday granted bail after their arrest in 1993.
- Former president Kamuzu Banda says the parliamentary boycott by opposition parties is justified and right in order to prevent the weakening of the opposition.

- Opposition members of Parliament currently boycotting parliamentary proceedings would not lose their allowances and benefits as they were attached to their tenure of office, clerk of the National Assembly Roosevelt Gondwe said.
